# API OpenAgenda


## en

- [Agendas](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/agendas.md): View parameters and data related to one or more agendas, excluding events
- [Agenda Configuration](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/agendas/lecture.md): View the configuration, a content summary, and the schema of an agenda.
- [List Agendas Where the Account is a Member](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/agendas/mes-agendas.md): An account can be a member of one or more agendas. This route allows you to list them
- [Search](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/agendas/recherche.md): List and search for agendas published and indexed on OpenAgenda
- [Schemas and Additional Fields](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/agendas/schemas.md): Details on how the event schema of an agenda and additional fields work.
- [List an Agenda's Sources](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/agendas/sources.md): Retrieve the main information of an agenda's source agendas
- [For your AI agents](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/agents-ia.md): Resources for AI agents and tooling working with the OpenAgenda API
- [Authentication](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/authentification.md): How to authenticate before making API calls for reading or editing.
- [Events of an agenda](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/evenements.md): View and edit events of an agenda
- [Creating an event](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/evenements/creation.md): Create a new event on an agenda using the standard method or with an external identifier
- [Editing an event](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/evenements/edition.md): Update an event on an agenda using the standard method or with an external identifier
- [JSON Export](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/evenements/export-json.md): ⚠️ Important note: Do not use this export for any new implementation. Use the reading functions described here - The JSON export documented here will be permanently removed at the end of 2025.
- [Migration from JSON Export to the API](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/evenements/export-json-migration.md): The JSON export, in place since 2015 and deprecated since 2022, reaches end-of-life at the end of 2025. Plan to update your scripts & applications that use it to switch to the v2 API, in place since 2018. This guide aims to provide the useful elements to ensure a smooth migration.
- [Reading events](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/evenements/lecture.md): List or view an event from an agenda
- [Event structure](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/evenements/structure.md): Details on standard fields, additional fields and other agenda-specific fields
- [Deleting an event](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/evenements/suppression.md): Delete an event or remove it from an agenda
- [Upcoming changes](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/evolutions.md): Planned or in-discussion changes to the OpenAgenda API
- [Ticketing data integration: offers](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/evolutions/billetterie.md): Structured pricing and availability for events
- [API key permissions](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/evolutions/cles-api.md): Key expiry and authorization scope
- [Preparing a data source](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/guides/source-de-donnees.md): Best practices for setting up an export that will serve as the primary data source for synchronization to an OpenAgenda.
- [Locations](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/lieux.md): View and edit the locations of an agenda
- [Creating a location](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/lieux/creation.md): Create a location on an agenda using the standard method or with an external identifier
- [Editing a location](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/lieux/edition.md): Update a location on an agenda using the standard method or with an external identifier
- [Reading locations](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/lieux/lecture.md): List or view a location of an agenda
- [Structure of a location](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/lieux/structure.md): Details on the fields that make up a location
- [Deleting a location](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/lieux/suppression.md): Permanently delete a location from an agenda
- [Agenda Members](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/membres.md): List
- [Plugins & integrations](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/plugins.md): Integrate your OpenAgenda on your website
- [Node.js Portal](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/plugins/agenda-portal.md): A node.js library that allows you to deploy a white-label event portal. It is available on npm and on github.
- [Drupal Extension](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/plugins/drupal.md): The Drupal module allows you to integrate your agendas hosted on https://openagenda.com directly on your Drupal 8, 9, or 10 site.
- [Embed code](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/plugins/embeds.md): This code is available from the export modal of any agenda published on OpenAgenda. It allows you to easily integrate a functional agenda with filters, list view, and detail view on a website.
- [Typo3 Extension](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/plugins/typo3.md): The Typo3 extension for OpenAgenda allows you to integrate one or more agendas as white-label directly on your Typo3 sites version 10.3 or later.
- [WordPress Plugin](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/plugins/wordpress.md): The OpenAgenda WordPress plugin allows you to easily integrate OpenAgenda events into your WordPress site. It is published on the official wordpress.org directory and is available under the MIT license on github.com.
- [Introduction](https://developers.openagenda.com/en/index.md): Documentation on the OpenAgenda API and other technical information
